basic_details.job_title: PGIMER Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 DEO and Field Worker Posts
basic_details.short_information: Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research, Chandigarh (PGIMER) has notified 2 contractual vacancies for Data Entry Operator and Field Worker posts on a purely temporary basis for an initial period of 6 months. Qualifications vary by post, with consolidated monthly pay specified as Rs. 20,000 for Data Entry Operator and Rs. 25,000 for Field Worker. Eligible candidates must apply by email by submitting a complete one-page signed bio-data on or before 21 October 2026 at 5:00 PM, as hardcopies are not entertained. rows.details: Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research (PGIMER), Chandigarh
Prevalence and incidence of metabolic disorders among cab drivers engaged in frequent outstation travel
Initially offered for 6 months, extendable up to a total duration of 12 months
Rs. 20,000/- per month (Data Entry Operator) / Rs. 25,000/- per month (Field Worker)

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification covers a total of 2 contractual vacancies across two distinct posts under the extramural project.

rows.essential_qualification: Class 12 pass from a recognized board and Bachelor's Degree/Diploma in Computer Applications/Information Technology
Class 12 pass from a recognized board and B.Sc./Diploma in Medical Lab Technology

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The positions are purely on a temporary basis for the current project. Appointments are initially offered for a period of 6 months and may be extended subsequently for a total duration of 12 months based on satisfactory performance. Emoluments are consolidated at Rs. 20,000/- per month for the Data Entry Operator and Rs. 25,000/- per month for the Field Worker.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for PGIMER Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare a complete one-page bio-data duly signed by yourself. Send the scanned bio-data only via email to the official project address at [email protected] . Ensure the email and application reach the specified inbox on or before October 21, 2026 (Wednesday) till 5 pm. Hardcopies of applications will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be informed via email regarding the timing of the interview by October 25, 2026.
